subject: Re: Accommodation and Transportation Information
body:
Dear Anna Wilson,

Thank you for your email regarding ICCBDA 2027, which will be held May 21–23, 2027 at Xihua University, Chengdu, China.

Regarding hotels near the conference venue: accommodation information has not yet been announced. Please watch the official conference announcements for updates.

Regarding transportation from Chengdu Tianfu International Airport to the university: this information is not currently available in the conference materials. Please refer to the conference secretariat or official conference announcements for further details.

For additional assistance, you may contact the conference secretariat at iccbda2027@example.org.

Best regards,
ICCBDA 2027 Organizing Committee
